title: What to Know Before You Advertise on Netflix in 2025

facts.fact: Netflix has grown to 70 million monthly active users on its ad-supported subscription since its 2022 launch, according to the page, which cites a Netflix newsroom post.
facts.quote: has grown to 70MM monthly active users on its ad-supported subscription since its launch in 2022

facts.fact: The page says Netflix has reportedly lowered its advertiser entry point to a minimum of $15,000 per month; the page does not name the source of this report.
facts.quote: While Netflix has reportedly lowered its entry-point for advertisers with a minimum of $15,000 per month

facts.fact: The vendor states that Amazon Prime Video's ad-supported platform has 175+ million monthly active viewers, and the page gives no source for this figure.
facts.quote: Amazon has a larger scale, with 175+ MM monthly active viewers on its ad-supported platform.

facts.fact: The article was originally published on November 26, 2024, and the page also shows a later date of July 1, 2026.
